Discord rich presence can now be used to invite players to matchmaking lobbies. Steam profile must be public.

Updated dependencies and new map support. Releasing an update in response to new maps is no longer necessary!

* Added Discord Rich Presence support for Danger Zone

* Main menu music no longer plays in warmup

* update dependencies, fix bug

* discord rich presence

Fix Linux icon

Just updated Electron to 3.0.0. That is all.

Also the auto updater doesn't seem to be working for me... If it's not working for you, just grab the latest release and install manually. Sorry 😥
Updated dependencies, fixed a couple bugs
Asks if you would like to download a sample music kit if no kits are found.

Music Kitten has been completely rewritten. Changes include:

- Better code that makes more sense and is easier to change and maintain
- Uses Howler.js for audio playback instead of hacking together some HTML5 audio players
- Automatically detects CS:GO's install location
- Ability to test music kits within the software without playing CS:GO
- Many other improvements and bug fixes
Fixed a bug with the bug fix.
I think I finally fixed that pesky bug with the menu audio.
Due to a vulnerability in an older version of Electron, Kitten was updated to use the latest version.

name: Music Kitten 1.0.1
body:
Here are the notable changes:

* Mute button to silence Music Kitten
* Option to disable playing win/lose/MVP tracks (if you still want to hear other people's in-game MVP anthems)
* Better, more appealing interface

name: Music Kitten 1.0.0
body:
# Kitten Initial Release

All the main features are there and work most of the time. Hopefully by releasing these binaries, more people will be willing to try it out and help me locate bugs and incorporate more features.

Competitive and demolition work great. Casual probably also works fine. Other game modes may have some interesting quirks.

The CSS is pretty minimal at this point. This should improve down the road.
